question: Who among the following laid the foundation stone for the world's third-largest cricket stadium in Jaipur in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **"Sourav Ganguly".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **February 5, 2022,** **Rajasthan Chief Minister**, **Ashok Gehlot **and **BCCI **President **Sourav Ganguly** laid the muse stone of the world’s third-biggest cricket stadium in **Jaipur.** 
 
• The International Cricket Stadium in Jaipur is the second-largest cricket stadium in **India** and the third-largest in the **world.**
 
• The new international stadium was built by the **Rajasthan Cricket Academy **(RCA) on the **Jaipur-Delhi** bypass, over** 100** acres of land in Jaipur.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of **75,000** spectators.
 
• **11** cricket pitches, **2** practice grounds, a cricket academy, a hostel, a gym, a restaurant as well a conference hall will be constructed in this state-of-the-art stadium built by the Rajasthan Cricket Association. 
 
• With the development of **SMS** Stadium in **Jaipur**, **Barkatullah Khan** Stadium in Jodhpur, the stadium being constructed in **Udaipur** and the **International Stadium** at Champ close to **Jaipur**, **Rajasthan** could have **4 **stadiums of worldwide standard. 
 
• It is noteworthy that the Rajputana Cricket Association became shaped in **Rajasthan** in **1931**.
 
• At present, there are cricket establishments in **33** districts of the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Navjot Singh Sidhu:**

 
 
• **Navjot Singh Sidhu** (**born 20 October 1963**) is an **Indian National **Congress politician, television person and retired **global cricketer.**
 
• He is the former **President** of the** Punjab Pradesh** Congress Committee. 
 
• Formerly, he was the** Minister** of Tourism and Cultural Affairs in the **state **government of the **State** of Punjab.
 
 
 
• **Rahul Dravid:**
 
 
• **Rahul Sharad Dravid** is an **Indian cricket coach** and former captain of the **Indian national team**, currently serving as its head coach.
 
• Prior to his appointment to the senior men's country-wide team, **Dravid** changed into the Head of Cricket at the **National Cricket Academy **(NCA), and the top teacher of the India Under-19 and India A teams. 
 
• Under his tutelage, the **under-19 **crew completed runners-up in the** 2016 U-19 Cricket World Cup** and received the **2018 U-19 Cricket World Cup.**
 
• Known for his sound batting technique, **Dravid** scored **24,177** runs in global cricket and is drastically regarded as one of the greatest batsmen withinside the information of cricket. 
 
 
 
• **Gautam Gambhir :**
 
 
• **Gautam Gambhir** is an** Indian politician** and **former cricketer,** who has played all formats of the game.
 
• He is a member of the **Lok Sabha** since **2019**. 
 
• He received **Padma Shri** from the **Government of India** in **2019**, the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
• As a cricketer, he was a left-handed opening batsman who played domestic cricket for **Delhi **and captained **Kolkata Knight Riders** and **Delhi Daredevils** in the **Indian Premier League (IPL).**
